journeyGroups.why: Why now: completing the observed HR-admin onboarding flow created a new employee and an independent directory readback retained the selected employment and equipment data. Observations: 145 and 150 (hannah.blake).

scenarios.name: Create an employee through onboarding and find the created record
scenarios.gherkin:
Given Hannah Blake has entered valid personal and job details for a new employee
And Hannah Blake has selected a laptop and chosen not to include a welcome kit
When Hannah Blake creates the employee from the review step
Then the onboarding completion confirms the new employee was added
And the employee directory shows the created employee with the entered employment details and selected equipment

journeyGroups.why: Why now: an employee's partial saved weekly draft was observed to become a persisted submitted timesheet whose hour inputs and actions remain disabled after reload. Observations: 68, 72, and 77 (Emily.dawson).

scenarios.name: Submit a saved partial weekly timesheet and retain its lock
scenarios.gherkin:
Given Emily Dawson has a saved editable weekly timesheet draft with recorded hours
When Emily Dawson submits the weekly timesheet
Then the submitted timesheet retains its recorded hours
And the hour inputs, Save draft action, and Submit week action are disabled after reload
